description: A University of Virginia SPW release provides a coarse synthetic population for Delhi, India. The open Zenodo record states CC BY 4.0 and lists an archive of CSV tables, a README, a contact matrix and validation plots. The README identifies person, household, residence, activity-place and person-to-place assignment files. Its household input is DHS, with GPW counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places also listed. The package can seed agents and activity destinations for metropolitan service-demand or evacuation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Delhi release. A limitation is that synthetic daily contacts and activity sites do not establish observed metro or road trips, travel times or infrastructure capacity. The source description does not say whether the region matches the administrative territory or a wider urban area. The archive was not downloaded and no location coordinate or population total was independently checked.
